title: 第3章 又要死？
slug: 每晚死在犯罪现场警局等我诈尸
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林知渔坐在椅子上，等了大概十分钟，姜南溪才走了过来，“已经安排人进行调查了，现在，你应该可以说一下你是怎么知道这些的吗？”

林知渔很认真地看着姜南溪的眼睛，“警官，你会相信我吗？”

她长了一双杏眼，瞳色清浅，水灵灵的，自带几分温顺恬淡，看着不像是会骗人的人。

“你说，我们会判断的。”

林知渔深吸一口气，道：“我本来是在酒店睡觉的，但是一睁开眼睛的时候……”

她将昨晚经历的一切都告诉了眼前这名警官，或许是想求个答案，又或许只是单纯地想找个人来倾诉这一切。

“你的意思是，你一失去意识，就会出现在某个案发现场，只要被杀，就会醒来？”

“是的。”

姜南溪皱紧了眉头，半晌，她才试探性地说出了口：“林小姐，你有没有去看过……心理医生？”

林知渔微愣，她连忙说：“我没有……不是，我是正常的。”

同一时刻。

三名穿着便服的警察快步走进殡仪馆，询问前台：“余时夏的尸体呢？”

“刚送去火化炉了。”

“立刻停止！”

林知渔坐在询问室里，等候进一步的调查。

临近中午，姜南溪才来通知林知渔可以回去了。

林知渔却不想走，“余时夏的案子调查得怎么样了？现在网上发酵的挺厉害的。”

“钱海就在你隔壁审讯。”

林知渔眼前一亮，“所以，我说的是不是对的？”

“……是对的，余时夏并不死于自杀，她在跳楼前就已经死了。”姜南溪说，“还好你来得及时，晚五分钟，尸体恐怕就火化了。”

此时的林知渔无比的确幸自己做出了这个决定。

“那我就先走了。”

刚出询问室，林知渔没走两步，就被一道熟悉的声音叫住了。

“林知渔。”

她身体一僵，下意识想跑。

下一秒，却被身后人抓住了手腕。

男人带着笑意的声音响起：“你是心虚吗？”

林知渔无奈，看向了身旁高大的男人，此时此刻，她觉得自己像极了狸猫爪子下的老鼠。

“周停云，你怎么在这？真巧啊，哈哈……”林知渔尬笑两句。

周停云问：“为什么要离家出走？”

林知渔有些尴尬地摸了摸鼻子，“你不是知道吗？”

“假千金？”周停云眯了眯眼睛，“就因为这个？这可不像你的性子。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lin Zhiyu sat on a chair and waited for about ten minutes before Jiang Nanxi came over and said, "People have been arranged to conduct an investigation. Now, can you tell me how you know this?"

Lin Zhiyu looked into Jiang Nanxi's eyes seriously, "Officer, will you believe me?"

She has a pair of almond-shaped eyes, which are light and watery. She is somewhat gentle and calm, and she doesn't look like someone who can deceive others.

"You tell us, we'll judge."

Lin Zhiyu took a deep breath and said, "I was sleeping in the hotel, but when I opened my eyes..."

She told the police officer everything she had experienced last night, perhaps because she wanted an answer, or perhaps she simply wanted to find someone to talk to.

"You mean that as soon as you lose consciousness, you will appear at a crime scene and wake up as soon as you are killed?"

"Yes."

Jiang Nanxi frowned, and after a while, she tentatively said, "Ms. Lin, have you ever seen... a psychiatrist?"

Lin Zhiyu was slightly stunned, and she quickly said: "I didn't... No, I'm normal."

same moment.

Three policemen in civilian clothes quickly walked into the funeral home and asked the front desk: "Where is Yu Shixia's body?"

"It was just sent to the cremator."

"Stop it now!"

Lin Zhiyu sat in the interrogation room, waiting for further investigation.

It was close to noon when Jiang Nanxi came to inform Lin Zhiyu that he could go back.

Lin Zhiyu didn't want to leave, "How is the investigation of Yu Shixia's case going? It's quite popular online now."

"Qian Hai is interrogating right next door to you."

Lin Zhiyu's eyes lit up, "So, is what I said right?"

"...That's right. Yu Shixia did not die of suicide. She died before jumping off the building." Jiang Nanxi said, "Fortunately, you arrived in time. Five minutes later, the body would have been cremated."

At this time, Lin Zhiyu was extremely lucky that he had made this decision.

"Then I'll leave first."

As soon as he left the interrogation room, Lin Zhiyu was stopped by a familiar voice before he took two steps.

"Lin Zhiyu."

Her body stiffened and she subconsciously wanted to run.

The next second, the person behind him grabbed his wrist.

The man's voice sounded with a smile: "Are you guilty?"

Lin Zhiyu had no choice but to look at the tall man beside her. At this moment, she felt like a mouse under the claws of a civet cat.

"Zhou Tingyun, why are you here? What a coincidence, haha..." Lin Zhiyu laughed awkwardly.

Zhou Tingyun asked: "Why did you run away from home?"

Lin Zhiyu touched his nose awkwardly, "Don't you know?"

"False daughter?" Zhou Tingyun narrowed his eyes, "Because of this? This is not like your temperament."
